sn45.140:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici jaṅgamānaṃ pāṇānam padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti ||
sn45.140:1.2: hatthipadaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam mahantattena ||
sn45.140:1.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā || appamādo tesaṃ dhammānam aggam akkhāyati || || 3.
sn45.140:1.4: Appamattassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati ||
